text: The UCLA Encyclopedia of Egyptology is an open-access scholarly encyclopedia created and reviewed by Egyptologists. Use individual articles for modern summaries of history, religion, archaeology, language, and material culture; retain article title, author, date, pages, and URL.
manual_review: Select and cite the specific article, not only the encyclopedia homepage

text: Digital Egypt for Universities is a university teaching resource covering Egyptian history, archaeology, language, religion, objects, and sites. Use it for accessible orientation and object/site metadata, then corroborate major claims with scholarly articles.

The Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History provides curator-authored essays and object context. Use it for art history, chronology, iconography, and museum object context, not as the only authority for dictionary meanings.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art - Heilbrunn Timeline

text: The British Museum Collection database provides object records, dates, materials, provenance fields, and collection identifiers. Preserve object number, record URL, rights, and the date accessed.
